in_sanskrit.name: महातो
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Maha means great and To means self or being. So Mahato means great being or great soul.

in_hindi.name: महातो
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bada or Mahan in Hindi means big or great. So Mahato in Hindi means great or big being.

in_tamil.name: மகாதோ
in_tamil.long_meaning: Makan in Tamil means big or great. So Mahato in Tamil means great being or big soul.

in_telugu.name: మేహేదో
in_telugu.long_meaning: Mevu in Telugu means great or big. So Mahato in Telugu means great or big being.

in_marathi.name: Mahato
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahato हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahato is a name of Sanskrit origin that means 'Great', 'Mighty'. It is a unisex name that is highly revered in Hindu culture and is often given to children born into powerful and influential families.
